note: Four mission clusters. The console proposes them from place memory and mission state; each carries the gate its flight is scored against. Status 'simulation' launches in the simulator today; 'planned' is proposed and recorded but cannot be flown yet.

clusters.name: Map an unknown space
clusters.question: What does this space look like?
clusters.produces: Occupancy map, observation images at each station, return to launch

fields.label: Simulated layout seed
fields.note: Simulation only; a real flight uses the paired aircraft instead

launch.note: Flies the blind exploration mission in the simulator from this console. On hardware this becomes the first flight after commissioning.

clusters.name: Audit a known space
clusters.question: Is each listed item where it should be?
clusters.produces: A verdict per listed item with image evidence and a located position

fields.label: Items to find
fields.note: Only the qualified target can be flown today; other items are recorded as unsupported

launch.note: Composes the brief, then the reviewed plan is launched as today. The qualified target is the red fire extinguisher.

clusters.name: Watch for changes
clusters.question: What changed since the last visit?
clusters.starts_from: Known map with a completed earlier visit as baseline
clusters.produces: A list of changes against the baseline; nothing changed is a valid result

launch.note: Needs the map of an earlier visit reused on the next one, which is the next software item. The console proposes it and records the request; it cannot fly it yet.

clusters.name: Find something in an unknown space
clusters.question: Where is it?
clusters.produces: Target position and image before full coverage

launch.note: Combines both capabilities in one flight. Not implemented; proposed so the demand is recorded.
